newsitem.title: ITALY: Ciampi says Italy's SEAT to be sold by mid-June.
newsitem.headline: Ciampi says Italy's SEAT to be sold by mid-June.

text.p: Italian Treasury Minister Carlo Azeglio Ciampi said due diligence on telephone directories publishing group SEAT SpA will be completed by April 16 and its sale would be carried out by mid-June.
Ciampi was addressing the public works commission of the upper house Senate.

SEAT was floated off from state-controlled telecoms group Stet at the beginning of this year with state industrial group IRI holding a 61 percent stake. Ciampi had previously said SEAT's sale would be completed by this spring.
In February, ITT Corp said it was seeking along with other partners to acquire SEAT.
IRI has said it has received eight non-binding offers for SEAT.
